d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, 15-20 minute me Bangalore Style wala Benne Dosa bana raha hu, ye multigrain dose hai, aur podi masala dal ke banayenge, instant recipe hai, aur super crispy soft result milti hai. Aap bhi try karna!
Recipe:
Multigrain Benne Dosa recipe
Poha - 1/2 cup
Rice flour - 1/4 cup
Besan - 1/4 cup
Suji - 1/4 cup
Malted Ragi flour - 1/4 cup
